parsed.review_summary: The candidate_edit correctly addresses all three error targets: (1) it acknowledges the comment references a concrete methodological aspect (one translator per language) rather than claiming no unique aspect is referenced; (2) it recognizes the comment is specific about what is wrong (single-translator insufficiency); and (3) it avoids the score-mapping error by noting that not being fully grounded does not automatically imply the lowest score, instead pointing to an intermediate rubric level. The rationale preserves coherent reasoning, does not invent evidence, and does not state a numeric final score or gold label.
